purpose: Battle readability map palette variants; clean backgrounds are independent of live effects.

prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: clean opaque top-down 2D arena background for an existing Phaser game, painterly forest ruins style. Input image is the existing arena map to edit. Preserve exactly the original overhead camera and landscape aspect approximately 22:16, outer ruined stone arches and forest perimeter, the central circular engraved rune, existing fully open walkable interior with no obstacles added. Change only palette, ground materials, visual busyness and lighting. The entire playable central 80 percent should be calm, moderately lit desaturated neutral earth and weathered grey stone, broad soft tonal variation and sparse paving fragments, very low-contrast tiny details. Remove the yellow-green grass carpet from the playable center; keep very sparse subdued vegetation only at its margins. Outer forest greenery remains but is less saturated. Reduce cyan central rune to a dim matte engraving with no bloom or emissive glow. Perimeter torches and crystals have tiny subtle glows only. Soft diffuse daylight, no strong sun patches, no dark night, no high-contrast cracks, no bright warm-yellow paving. This asset is the CLEAN map only: NO characters, NO circular portrait tokens, NO attacks, NO warning circles, NO projectiles, NO poison, NO red markings, NO overlay UI, NO text, NO side-by-side comparison, no frame. Single full-bleed landscape background, target about 1536x1120. Variant A GREY BROWN RUINS: greige limestone fragments and neutral grey-brown taupe soil, warm-neutral ambient light. Green trees only on outer rim.
